theme: Dicarboxylate transport feeding glutamate-aspartate nitrogen metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways cover sodium-coupled uptake of TCA intermediates (succinate, citrate, alpha-ketoglutarate). Here they act as the supply of carbon skeletons and shuttle substrates for glutamate/glutamine/aspartate interconversion, the malate-aspartate shuttle and ammonium handling.

theme: Mitotic centrosome maturation and spindle orientation
core_role: The shared pathways cover recruiting pericentriolar proteins and NuMA to mitotic centrosomes and activating Aurora A by TPX2. This builds the centrosome into the organizing hub that nucleates astral microtubules and assembles, positions and orients the mitotic spindle.

theme: NO/natriuretic peptide cGMP signalling controlling blood pressure
core_role: The shared pathways cover guanylyl-cyclase cGMP production and its outputs (vasodilation, natriuresis, diuresis, lower systemic and pulmonary pressure). Here they are the effector arm of eNOS-derived nitric oxide signalling that relaxes vascular smooth muscle.

theme: Cholinergic neuromuscular synaptic transmission
core_role: The shared pathways cover the presynaptic cholinergic arm: high-affinity choline uptake by SLC5A7, acetylcholine synthesis and acetylcholine release (with SLC5A7 defects causing motor neuronopathy). Together these supply transmitter to the postsynaptic nicotinic acetylcholine receptors.

theme: Rhesus glycoprotein-mediated ammonium and CO2 transport
core_role: The shared pathways cover biosynthesis of Rh blood group/RHAG membrane proteins and Rh-null disease. Here they are the gas-channel machinery that moves ammonia/ammonium and carbon dioxide across epithelial and erythrocyte membranes.

theme: Actin filament turnover driving protrusions and cell shape
core_role: The shared pathways cover cofilin/gelsolin-type actin disassembly: severing, depolymerization, barbed-end capping and restraint of Arp2/3 nucleation. This recycles actin so filopodia, ruffles and polarized cell shape can be remodelled downstream of EPHB and Rho-family signalling, including at synapses.

theme: Cytosolic DNA sensing and antiviral type I interferon induction
core_role: The shared pathways cover the effector outputs of cytosolic nucleic-acid sensors: IRF3-driven type I interferon, ZBP1/RIP-mediated NF-kB activation and AIM2 inflammasome assembly. They are how cGAS/STING-type DNA sensing becomes antiviral defense.

theme: Amino acid catabolism through glyoxylate and glycine metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways cover generic L-amino acid and amide catabolic/metabolic processes. Here they are the broad organic-acid degradation that converges on glyoxylate and glycine interconversion, including breakdown of non-proteinogenic amino acids.

theme: Hepatic hexose-phosphate metabolism: fructose, glycolysis, gluconeogenesis, glycogen
core_role: The shared pathways cover the fructose and glycerol entry routes (fructokinase, aldolase B, glycerol/glycerol-3-phosphate) and their inborn errors. Here they act as feeders into the hexose- and triose-phosphate pools used by glycolysis, gluconeogenesis and glycogen metabolism.

theme: Monocyte/myeloid inflammatory activation by endogenous danger signals
core_role: The shared pathways cover TLR and scavenger-type sensing by monocytes and myeloid cells of endogenous ligands such as oxidized LDL and heme. They form the trigger of myeloid inflammatory signalling, extended by complement-receptor signalling and neutrophil degranulation.

theme: Epigenetic chromatin regulation by histone and DNA methylation
core_role: The shared pathways cover the WDR5/MLL (KMT2D) histone lysine methyltransferase complexes, which are disrupted in Kabuki syndrome. They are the histone-methylation writer arm within a wider epigenetic programme that also includes repressive heterochromatin, DNA methylation, imprinting, X inactivation and retroelement silencing.

theme: Telomere protection and maintenance
core_role: The shared pathways cover shelterin-type end protection (capping telomeres, blocking NHEJ and limiting t-circle formation). This is the protective arm that sits alongside telomerase-mediated extension, C-strand fill-in synthesis and ATRX/DAXX-dependent suppression of telomeric recombination.

theme: Second heart field-driven cardiac morphogenesis
core_role: The shared pathways cover specification, proliferation and differentiation of second heart field progenitors. These cells build the right ventricle, the septum and the ascending aorta/outflow, with endocardial and mesenchymal contributions to valve morphogenesis.

theme: Phagocyte antimicrobial killing and host-pathogen interaction
core_role: The shared pathways cover the phagocyte microbicidal effector arm: the NADPH oxidase respiratory burst and ROS, neutrophil degranulation and cytotoxicity against bacteria and fungi. Antimicrobial peptides complement this arm, and pathogen evasion strategies (blocking phagosome acidification, metal sequestration and others) counter it.

theme: Chromatin remodeling and ADP-ribosylation at DNA double-strand breaks
core_role: The shared pathways cover nucleosome remodeling and assembly, PARP-driven ADP-ribosylation and recruitment of proteins to chromatin. Here they open and restore chromatin at DNA breaks so that DSB sensing and the choice between NHEJ and homologous recombination can proceed.

theme: HIV and herpesvirus replication cycle and host restriction
core_role: The shared pathways cover the early retroviral life cycle (entry, uncoating, reverse transcription, nuclear import, integration, latency), host restriction such as APOBEC3G, and control of viral transcription. Late-stage assembly and Nef/Vpu-mediated immune evasion complete the viral cycle.

theme: Monocyte/macrophage inflammatory activation and recruitment
core_role: The shared pathways cover monocyte activation and proinflammatory cytokine/chemokine output, including negative regulation of MCP-1 and macrophage cytokines. Here they are the tunable signal driving monocyte chemotaxis, extravasation and RAGE/scavenger receptor-triggered recruitment.

theme: Rho GTPase-driven actin remodeling in cell migration
core_role: The shared pathways cover actin filament structural dynamics (severing, capping, depolymerization, bundling, crosslinking, network formation). They form the cytoskeletal effector layer that Rho-family GTPases (RAC, CDC42, RHOA and others) direct to build lamellipodia, ruffles and motile protrusions.

theme: Post-transcriptional control of mRNA stability and decay
core_role: The shared pathways cover mRNA stabilization by RNA-binding proteins (IGF2BP, CRD-mediated) and promotion of cytoplasmic translation. They are the stabilizing counterweight to ARE-directed deadenylation and decapping decay driven by TTP, KSRP, AUF1 and BRF1.

theme: Glutamate, glutamine and aspartate nitrogen metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways cover the central glutamate/glutamine/aspartate interconversions and alpha-ketoglutarate transport. Here they are the nitrogen-handling hub that extends to arginine and citrulline (urea-cycle-adjacent) metabolism.

theme: Catecholamine synthesis and synaptic reuptake
core_role: The shared pathways cover dopamine biosynthesis and the regulation of presynaptic catecholamine metabolism and reuptake. Here they are the transmitter-supply side, coupled to monoamine (dopamine/norepinephrine) membrane transport.

theme: Mitochondrial tRNA processing and RNA pseudouridylation
core_role: The shared pathways cover mitochondrial tRNA maturation (3'-end processing and base modification). Here this is one setting for pseudouridine synthase activity, which also modifies rRNA and mRNA.

theme: Protein glycosylation and nucleotide-sugar supply
core_role: The shared pathways cover N-glycan assembly and processing (dolichol-glucose, mannose trimming, hybrid/complex branching, LacNAc elongation, sialylation). This is the protein-glycan building arm, fed by nucleotide-sugar synthesis and Golgi transport, alongside O-glycan and blood-group glycan synthesis and the CDG disorders.

theme: Telomere end protection and maintenance
core_role: The shared pathways cover the protected telomere state: capping, chromatin packaging, blocking NHEJ and t-circles, restraining telomerase, and ATRX/DAXX-dependent suppression of recombination. This state sits beside telomerase extension and C-strand synthesis.

theme: Bidirectional ER-Golgi vesicle trafficking
core_role: The shared pathways cover COPI vesicle budding and Golgi-to-ER retrograde traffic. This is the retrieval and recycling counterpart to COPII-mediated cargo export from ER exit sites.

theme: Embryonic heart morphogenesis and outflow tract development
core_role: The shared pathways cover heart tube patterning, second heart field and cardiac neural crest contributions, ventricle formation, and outflow tract septation with great artery morphogenesis. This is the structural morphogenesis that atrioventricular and conduction system development extend.

theme: Aquaporin water and solute transport in renal water homeostasis
core_role: The shared pathways cover aquaglyceroporin and urea channel transport of small neutral solutes (glycerol, urea). They sit beside vasopressin-regulated aquaporin water reabsorption in the kidney, where urea transport contributes to urine concentration.

theme: Control of thymocyte and hematopoietic cell numbers
core_role: The shared pathways cover thymic regulation of immature T cell proliferation, survival and differentiation. Here this is one instance of tissue cell-number homeostasis, paralleled by proliferation and apoptosis control in bone marrow.

theme: Recombinational repair of replication-associated DNA breaks
core_role: The shared pathways cover repair DNA synthesis and sister-chromatid-exchange repair of replication-born double-strand breaks. These are recombination-based fork repair steps, together with strand invasion, SDSA, fork reversal, interstrand cross-link repair and DNA topology changes.

theme: Endosome-Golgi retrograde and recycling transport
core_role: The shared pathways cover bidirectional endosome-Golgi transport and Golgi protein retention. This is the sorting route within wider endosomal recycling, receptor return to the plasma membrane and lysosomal hydrolase delivery.

theme: COPI vesicle traffic and Golgi organization
core_role: The shared pathways cover COPI vesicle budding for Golgi-to-ER retrograde and intra-Golgi anterograde transport. Here this trafficking engine maintains Golgi structure, ribbon assembly and disassembly, and constitutive secretion.

theme: cGAS-STING sensing and dendritic cell cytokine responses
core_role: The shared pathways cover STING pathway activation, including import of extracellular cGAMP, and the resulting cytokine production by myeloid dendritic cells. Here this is innate antimicrobial signalling linked to CCL5 chemokine regulation, GBP-mediated defense and inflammasome activity.

theme: Xenobiotic and drug metabolism (phase I/II detoxification)
core_role: The shared pathways cover the core phase I oxidation (cytochromes, alcohol oxidation) and phase II sulfonation that detoxify toxins, mycotoxins, ethanol and steroids. Here this is the generic detoxification machinery that drug ADME, CYP/FMO reactions and conjugations apply.

theme: Actin remodeling for filopodia, polarity and adhesion
core_role: The shared pathways cover filopodium formation, cell polarity and postsynaptic actin organization downstream of EPHB and RHOF. This is protrusion control that connects to actin bundling and crosslinking and to integrin-ILK focal adhesion and spreading.

theme: Erythrocyte gas exchange and ammonium/CO2 transport
core_role: The shared pathways cover erythrocyte membrane and hemoglobin transport of oxygen, CO2, NO and ammonia, including through Rh/RHAG glycoproteins. Here this is respiratory gas and acid-base exchange, supported by carbonic anhydrase and lactate/MCT-basigin transport.

theme: Protein methylation linked to ribosome biogenesis and translation
core_role: The shared pathways cover lysine and arginine methylation of proteins, including p53, responding to methionine availability. Here this is a nutrient-sensitive modification layer regulating ribosome biogenesis and cap-dependent translation initiation.

theme: Fibroblast mechanotransduction and matrix remodeling
core_role: The shared pathways cover Rho-driven stress fiber and focal adhesion assembly, syndecan signalling and SRF-target cytoskeletal remodeling. This is the mechanosensing apparatus that drives YAP/TAZ-dependent matrix production, EMT-like stromal activation and fibroblast migration.

theme: Mitochondrial gene expression from RNA processing to translation
core_role: The shared pathways cover mitochondrial mRNA modification, FASTK-mediated processing and stability, RNA decay control and large mitoribosome assembly. This is the post-transcriptional machinery enabling mitochondrial translation, alongside mtDNA replication.

theme: B cell identity and differentiation to plasma cells
core_role: The shared pathways cover B-cell transcriptional module signatures marking the naive/memory B lymphocyte compartment and lymphoid activation. This is the starting compartment that germinal centre differentiation turns into memory B cells and immunoglobulin-secreting plasma cells.

theme: Vitamin K metabolism and protein gamma-carboxylation
core_role: The shared pathways cover quinone metabolism (vitamin K/menaquinone and ubiquinol synthesis and catabolism). Here they supply the vitamin K cofactor that gamma-carboxylates clotting factor precursors, next to fat-soluble vitamin E transport.

theme: Mitochondrial RNA processing and translation machinery
core_role: The shared pathways cover mitochondrial mRNA and rRNA modification, processing, stability and decay, together with mitoribosome subunit assembly. This is the core of mitochondrial gene expression, completed by mitochondrial tRNA processing and modification.

theme: Canonical and non-canonical NF-kB signalling and its regulation
core_role: The shared pathways cover canonical IKK recruitment and NF-kB activation downstream of TLR/IRAK1 and RIP1, plus SUMOylation of immune proteins. This is the central activation step among TNFR1, CD40 and NIK-driven non-canonical signalling, ubiquitin control and IKK-deficiency immunodeficiencies.

theme: Cytokine signalling regulating NK and lymphocyte responses
core_role: The shared pathways cover IL-15 and IL-21 common gamma-chain cytokine signalling driving NK cell proliferation and differentiation. This sits within a broader cytokine network (IL-10, IL-12/23/27, IL-20 family, interferons) shaping NK/NKT activation and inflammation.

theme: Lymphocyte antigen-receptor signalling, costimulation and inhibition
core_role: The shared pathways cover the T cell side of antigen-receptor activation: CD3/ZAP-70 proximal signalling, CD28 costimulation, and CTLA4/BTLA co-inhibition. This runs parallel to BCR signalling and to inhibitory receptor brakes on leukocyte activation.

theme: Germ cell and gonadal development
core_role: The shared pathways cover primordial germ cell migration, proliferation, survival and meiotic entry, plus Leydig differentiation and AMH/activin signalling. This is gonadal maturation within germ cell specification and male sex determination.

theme: Muscle growth and adaptive remodeling
core_role: The shared pathways cover control of cardiomyocyte size, sarcomere organization and hypertrophic adaptation. This is the cardiac case of muscle adaptation, alongside skeletal muscle atrophy, regeneration and fiber-type switching in response to activity.

theme: Sperm flagellar motility and spermatogenesis
core_role: The shared pathways cover sperm motility, mitochondrial sheath assembly, ciliary beating and the Sertoli cell barrier. These form the structural and energetic basis of the flagellum, supported by kinesins and microtubule severing and depolymerization.

theme: Proline, ornithine and arginine/urea-cycle amino acid metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways cover glutamate-family amino acid interconversion: proline synthesis and catabolism, and citrulline metabolism. Through ornithine these link to arginine catabolism, the urea cycle and cationic amino acid transport (SLC7A7, SLC25A15).
